guide.title: How to use affiliated organizations
guide.description: Check and leave the organizations the team belongs to, and handle invitations and applications with organizations here. Only team admins and people entrusted with affiliation operations can use it.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.body: The organizations the team currently belongs to. Press "Leave" to leave after confirming. Once left, announcements from that organization no longer reach the team.

invites.title: Received invitations
invites.body: Membership invitations sent by organizations. "Accept" to join, "Decline" to refuse. When declining you can choose "Do not accept in future" to block invitations from that organization.

applications.title: Pending applications
applications.body: Applications the team has sent to organizations. While waiting for a reply you can cancel them with "Withdraw". Once approved, the organization appears under Organizations.

restrictions.title: Invitation blocks
restrictions.body: Invitations you have blocked by declining. Press "Lift" to let that organization invite the team again.

permission_groups.title: Permission groups
permission_groups.hint: The team's permission groups. People in a group that includes "Manage organization affiliation" can apply to organizations and accept invitations without being an admin. Grant or remove it with the "Permission groups" button for each member on the member list (team admins only).
